instructions.drag-match: Drag the item on the left onto its pair on the right!
instructions.fill-blank: Drag words or numbers to fill in the missing spots!
instructions.memory-cards: Flip cards to find all matching pairs!
instructions.word-builder: Arrange letters in order to build the word!
instructions.math-race: Solve quickly to boost your race car across the finish line!
instructions.sort-order: Arrange items in correct ascending or chronological sequence!
instructions.true-false-swipe: Swipe RIGHT for True, swipe LEFT for False!
instructions.listen-pick: Press speaker to hear the word, then pick the matching picture!
instructions.clock-reader: Drag clock hands to the requested time!
instructions.balloon-pop: Pop the balloon displaying the correct answer!
instructions.catch-fall: Move your basket to catch items that match the rule!
